title: Pakistani Chicken Tikka
description:
Pakistani Chicken Tikka 😋

4lbs chicken thighs 
1 cup full fat yogurt 
8 cloves garlic, mashed
1 inch ginger, mashed 
Q tbsp kasuri methi (I put more on accident) 
1/4 cup cilantro 
2 tsp mustard oil (regular is fine) 
1 packet chicken tikka spices 
1/2 lemon, juiced 
Salt to taste 

Yogurt chutney: 
2 cups yogurt 
1 bundle cilantro 
2 cloves garlic 
1 jalapeño (or 2 tsp crushed jalapeño dust)
1 lemon, juiced 
Salt to taste 

Optional:
Brush with garlic cilantro butter
